experiment: node-tar v1-frame projection native end-to-end validation
purpose: Confirm, on a REAL node-tar run (not a reference/synthetic trace), that the pipeline producer -> inodefence-boundary-attempt-v1 frame -> normalizer -> M3.1 feedback keys emits and normalizes consistently, i.e. the projection yields exactly the keys node-tar's direct M3.1 trace derivation produces.
reproduction: make node-tar-effect-check  (host docker; runs tests/container_integration/check_node_effect_producer.py inside the N04 controller)

target.note: 7.5.22 is a fixed release; its containment rejects an escaping hardlink. The :7.5.x M2 images are vulnerable but carry no effect producer, so no vulnerable+producer image exists on this host.

isolation: N04 controller + disposable sandbox + sentinel; --network none, --read-only, --cap-drop ALL, non-root, tmpfs. No isolation relaxation.

observed.pipeline_consistency: For every real qualification trace (regular-file, directory-metadata, hardlink-identity, symlink, duplicate-path, directory-child, independent-files, partial-rejection), boundary_attempt_frame_from_effect_trace(trace) -> frame_boundary_attempt_keys(frame) equals the direct boundary_attempt_keys(trace) | external_resolve_keys(trace), up to the frame's documented outcome coarsening (exact for SUCCEEDED link ops). Asserted inside the real-producer check; passed.

finding.pipeline_validated_observed: The real node-tar producer -> v1 frame -> normalizer -> M3.1 key pipeline runs end-to-end on real traces, and the projection is observationally equivalent to node-tar's direct M3.1 derivation on every real trace (both empty where there is no boundary attempt).
finding.fixed_version_rejects_pre_link_observed: node-tar 7.5.22 rejected the escaping hardlink before any link syscall, so the producer recorded no LINK operation and no external affected path; the projection correctly yields no boundary key, consistent with the direct derivation. A recorded boundary-attempt therefore requires a version that reaches fs.link.
finding.boundary_positive_key_not_observed_here: A gradient-driving boundary-attempt key from a real node-tar run was NOT observed in this plumbing-consistency gate, because the only producer-carrying image is the fixed 7.5.22. It is established by composition: M2 (experiments/repro/cross_release_identity.py) shows 7.5.2 creates the escaping hardlink aliasing the external sentinel inode, and the synthetic equivalence proof (tests/test_boundary_attempt_frame_projection.py) shows the projection of such a trace yields the boundary-attempt + external-resolve keys. The observed positive key is the domain of the A/B/C/D boundary-attempt differential run on a vulnerable arm.
finding.classification: demo run (validation); observed vs composition-inferred distinguished above. Not a fuzzer-discovery or effectiveness claim.
